description_en: Queries virus scheduled scan policies under the current Alibaba Cloud account with paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的病毒定时扫描策略
name: ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan path scopes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描的路径范围集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan performance modes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描性能模式集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: performance_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus scheduled scan policy IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 病毒定时扫描策略ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en: The policy name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、连字符（-）
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en:
Filters policies by enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: enabled.
Disabled: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
按启用状态过滤。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID. This parameter is used to filter policies whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的策略。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

Strategies.description_en: The list of scheduled virus scan policies
Strategies.description_zh: 病毒定时扫描策略列表

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The time is in UTC+8
CreateTime.description_zh: 策略创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The distinguished name (DN) of the organization chart node

HighRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
HighRiskOperation.description_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件

LastTriggerTime.description_en: The time when the policy last triggered a scan, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The time is in UTC+8. An empty string is returned if the policy has never been triggered
LastTriggerTime.description_zh: 策略最近一次触发扫描的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区。从未触发过时返回空字符串

LowRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: Take no action
LowRiskOperation.description_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs to which the policy applies. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

MaxCpuUsage.description_en: The maximum percentage of terminal CPU usage allowed during scanning
MaxCpuUsage.description_zh: 扫描时占用终端CPU的百分比上限

MidRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
MidRiskOperation.description_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件

PerformanceMode.description_en:
The scan performance schema pattern. Valid values:
SecurityFirst: Security first. The default CPU usage upper limit is 50%.
Balance: Balanced. The default CPU usage upper limit is 30%.
ExperienceFirst: Experience first. The default CPU usage upper limit is 15%
PerformanceMode.description_zh:
扫描性能模式。取值：
SecurityFirst：安全优先，CPU占用上限默认为50%。
Balance：均衡，CPU占用上限默认为30%。
ExperienceFirst：体验优先，CPU占用上限默认为15%

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高

ScanBeginTime.description_en: The start hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is a whole hour number ranging from 0 to 23, inclusive. This field is not a timestamp
ScanBeginTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳

ScanEndTime.description_en: The end hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is a whole hour number ranging from 1 to 24, exclusive of the specified hour, and must be greater than ScanBeginTime. The scan task generated by each trigger expires at this hour on the same day. This field is not a timestamp
ScanEndTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。每次触发生成的扫描任务在当天该整点失效。本字段不是时间戳

ScanFrequency.description_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: By day.
week: By week
ScanFrequency.description_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周

ScanInterval.description_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle. This parameter works together with ScanFrequency to determine the trigger cycle. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
ScanInterval.description_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan path scope. Valid values:
Quick: Quick scan. Only critical system directories and common risk locations are scanned.
Full: Full disk scan.
Custom: Custom path scan
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描的路径范围。取值：
Quick：快速扫描，仅扫描系统关键目录与常见风险位置。
Full：全盘扫描。
Custom：自定义路径扫描

ScanPath.description_en: The collection of custom scan paths

items.description_en: The custom scan path. The path supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), colons (:), percent signs (%), forward slashes (/), backslashes (), underscores (_), parentheses, tildes (~), square brackets, and hyphens (-). Commas are not supported
items.description_zh: 自定义扫描路径。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、冒号（:）、百分号（%）、正斜杠（/）、反斜杠（\）、下划线（_）、圆括号、波浪号（~）、方括号、连字符（-）。不支持逗号

ScanTargets.description_en: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan
ScanTargets.description_zh: 本次扫描要处置的病毒类型集合

items.description_en:
The virus type. Valid values:
Backdoor: Backdoor program.
DDoS: DDoS Trojan.
Downloader: Downloader Trojan.
Engtest: DPI engine test program.
Hacktool: Hacking tool.
Trojan: Self-mutating Trojan.
Malbaseware: Contaminated base software.
MalScript: Malicious script.
Malware: Malicious program.
Miner: Mining programs.
Proxytool: Proxy tool.
RansomWare: Ransomware.
RiskWare: Risky software.
Rootkit: Kernel-hidden program.
Stealer: Credential-stealing tool.
Scanner: Scanner.
Suspicious: Suspicious program.
Virus: File-infecting virus.
WebShell: Web shell.
Worm: Worms.
BlackList: File that hit the blacklist.
Exp: Vulnerability exploits program.
Patcher: Cracking program.
Gametool: Private server tool.
AdWare: Adware.
Maldoc: Malicious document
items.description_zh:
病毒类型。取值：
Backdoor：后门程序。
DDoS：DDoS木马。
Downloader：下载器木马。
Engtest：引擎测试程序。
Hacktool：黑客工具。
Trojan：自变异木马。
Malbaseware：被污染的基础软件。
MalScript：恶意脚本。
Malware：恶意程序。
Miner：挖矿程序。
Proxytool：代理工具。
RansomWare：勒索病毒。
RiskWare：风险软件。
Rootkit：内核隐藏程序。
Stealer：窃密工具。
Scanner：扫描器。
Suspicious：可疑程序。
Virus：感染型病毒。
WebShell：网站后门。
Worm：蠕虫病毒。
BlackList：命中黑名单的文件。
Exp：漏洞利用程序。
Patcher：破解程序。
Gametool：私服工具。
AdWare：广告程序。
Maldoc：恶意文档

Status.description_en:
The enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用

StrategyDescription.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端全盘扫描

StrategyId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled virus scan policy

Whitelist.description_en: The list of exempted users. Users in this list are excluded from the scan performed by this policy. An empty list is returned if no exemptions are configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。未配置时返回空列表

items.description_en: The username. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses
items.description_zh: 用户名。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、星号（*）、连字符（-）、@、空格、中间点（·）、圆括号

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of scheduled virus scan policies
TotalNum.description_zh: 病毒定时扫描策略总数
